_comment: Instance data for core/helpers/conditional-order-gate.cjs: regex strings that mark a CONDITION in the
operator's message — a sequencing word ('then', 'after your answer', 'once X is merged') or a delegated
decision ('clear it with X', 'X decides'). The built-ins are English; this file carries the operator's
own language. Example for a German operator: "\\bdann\\b", "\\bdanach\\b", "\\bsobald\\b",
A hit costs one line (CONDITION-MET or CONDITION-NONE) before an expensive or external call; keep the
list to words that really bind an order to an event.
_cases: the operator's real wording with the verdict the gate must reach on a Workflow call (block = a
condition is read); run by core/scripts/pattern-cases.py at every self-test. Replace the English examples.
